body_excerpt: This release aligns the Rust bindings with Skia milestone 157 in #1351, and includes cumulative updates since 0.156.0 (upstream Skia notes: https://skia.googlesource.com/skia/+/refs/heads/chrome/m157/RELEASE_NOTES.md). ## Notable Changes - Fixed aliasing violations at the FFI boundary that BorrowSanitizer found in `Canvas`, `PathBuilder`, the SVG containers, `TypefaceFontProvider`, `Document`, and the stream wrappers in #1359. This is a breaking change. The deprecated `Camera3D`, `Patch3D`, and `View3D` are removed, a PDF `Document` now keeps its writer borrowed until it is dropped, and `RefHandle` no longer offers `native_mut()`. `PathIterRec` now owns its points and is `Send` and `Sync`. - Updated expat to 2.10.0, which fixes four known vulnerabilities, in #1360. - Added the unsafe constructor `Typeface::from_ct_font()`, which creates a typeface from a Core Text `CTFont` on macOS,
